notes.drawing: Phosphor's stack: rhombus layers 192 wide and 112 tall (centerlines), 48 apart. One step uses two layers, centred (at 104 and 152); the moved layer is solid (accepted by the maintainer): the bottom layer, drawn as the band of its rhombus that lies more than 32 units (centerline to centerline) below the layer above it, so 16 units stay clear of that layer's edge in regular (8 in bold) and the band's ends are rounded.
notes.fill: The same drawing: the moved layer is already solid, and filling the other layers would hide which one moved.
notes.duotone: Tints the layer that didn't move.
